title: Marsember Ice Wine
summary: Provides 6 Camp Supplies. Drink for the Alcohol condition or throw to create an Alcohol surface.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Alcohol gives Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma checks for 2 turns.
fields.Throw: Action. Creates a persistent 13 ft radius Alcohol surface that can ignite or freeze.
fields.Camp Supplies: 6 points toward a full Long Rest.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
